entities.name: Akim, the Soaring Wind
entities.description: A legendary flying dinosaur from Ikoria, adopted by a flock of birds and now its leader.

events.summary: Orphaned as a hatchling, Akim was adopted by a flock of birds.
events.quote: Orphaned as a hatchling, the reptilian Akim was adopted by a flock of birds and embraced as a member of the family.

events.summary: Akim became flock leader and made the flock more aggressive.
events.quote: Under Akim's lead, the flock has grown more aggressive than ever before

relations.quote: Akim , the Soaring Wind is a legendary flying dinosaur from the plane of Ikoria .
